graph.title: Code knowledge graph
graph.description: A map of the repository's symbols and their relationships, extracted from the code by graphify.
graph.disabledHint: This repository has no code graph yet.
graph.disabledAbout1: The code graph maps every class, function and file of the repository as nodes, and their real relationships — calls, imports, inheritance — as edges, each with its exact file and line. It is extracted from the syntax tree of the code: deterministic, fully local, zero AI tokens.
graph.disabledAbout2: Once enabled it rebuilds itself on every push and gives you an interactive map of the codebase, a report of its most connected symbols and hidden cross-module links, and structural answers — "what calls this?", "how are these two modules connected?" — for you and for AI agents, instantly instead of grepping.
graph.disabledCredits: Powered by <0>graphify</0>, an open-source project by Graphify Labs (Apache 2.0) — our thanks to its authors.
